author: Associated Press Television News
title: Taiwan President Pledges To Defend Island’s Sovereignty Against China’s ‘Expansionist Ambitions’
text:
• The article was updated on January 1, 2026, at 10:44 IST.
• Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te vowed to defend the island’s sovereignty against China's "expansionist ambitions."
• Lai made the statement in his New Year's address.
• China recently concluded live-fire military drills around Taiwan.
• Lai stated his commitment to safeguarding national sovereignty, strengthening national defense, and constructing a democratic defense mechanism.
• China's Xi Jinping reiterated the threat of annexing Taiwan in his New Year's address.
• The U.S. plans to sell over $11 billion in arms to Taiwan, including missiles, drones, artillery systems, and military software.
• Taiwan announced a $40 billion budget for arms purchases, including an air defense system, to be allocated from 2026 to 2033.
• Lai pledged to raise defense spending to 5% of the island’s GDP.
